notes.title: M4 Tank Brigade Events
notes.notes:
All,

We will start to have M4 Online events in June, July, and August 2019.

We will have those events on the 2nd Sunday each month, or June 8, July 13th, and August 10th.

We will give away 3 FREE Months, Two Free Months, and One Free Month of full access to M4 and WarBirds Online.

Anyone who plays all three events will qualify for the $100.00 prize for the highest total score of all three events.  Second place will get $50.00 prize.

Practice today and win!

See you online!

IENT

notes.title: Early Access - Score Reset
notes.notes:
Due to ongoing work in the game, online player ranks and scores were reset today, Dec 15, 2015. Solo play accomplishments are not affected.

In an early access game, this kind of reset can occur from time to time. Think of it as your chance to erase all those early embarrassments and start fresh, with fewer mistakes!

There will be at least one more reset, possibly more, as we continue work on the game. An upcoming goal is to make in-game rewards more meaningful and useful, online as well as offline. This means tinkering with scoring logic and data.

notes.title: First Update Released for M4 Tank Brigade!
notes.notes:
The first of many updates to M4 Tank Brigade was released today (November 19, 2015). IENT delivers on the promise made to Early Access purchasers of M4 Tank Brigade. 

This first update completely overhauls how players control tanks in battle.  Viewing the battlefield, driving tanks, and firing the main gun have never been easier.  The classic point-drag-click map controls are easier to access, but still allow you to command units of multiple tanks. You can also detach single vehicles for special missions, then reform into your unit later. 

Learning the new controls is also easier. In addition to in-game help, there are new and old guides available from IENT at M4 Tank Brigade, Steam Community Guides [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/348810/guides/]here[/url].

The original, classic game controls remain available for those who prefer them. Budding game designers can even compare the two.

This update also introduces different turret rotation speeds and gun reloading rates for different tanks. The rates are based on the historical charactertistics of each tank. A handy reload indicator is also visible. 

Look for further information on future updates in M4 Tank Brigade, Steam Community Discussion, [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/348810/discussions/2/] Developers Talk[/url].

notes.title: M4 Tank Brigade Available Aug 17
notes.notes: M4 Tank Brigade will be available on Steam Early Access, on Monday, August 17 at approximately 9 AM Eastern / 6 AM Pacific for $14.99. This is a classic game of World War II multi-tank armored combat with solo and online multiplayer versions.
